meld.title: Report
meld.intro: Tell us in your own words what happened. We suggest the rest, and you check it before it is saved.
meld.placeholder: Write it the way you would tell a colleague: what happened, where and when, and who is affected.
meld.noTypes: You do not have access to report here. Talk to your manager or the person responsible for quality in the company.
meld.textRequired: Write a few words about what happened first.
meld.aiNote: Based on what you wrote and what we know about the company. Change anything that is not right.
meld.manualNote: Fill it in yourself – suggestions are not available right now.

fields.title: Short heading
fields.dueHint: When the case should be followed up.

severity.high: High – may have to be reported

deadline.gdpr72h: Decide on notifying the data protection authority by {{when}}
deadline.gdpr72hHint: 72 hours from when you became aware of it

meld.error: The case could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.

done.title: Thank you, it has been reported
done.created: {{code}} has been created and {{owner}} has been told. What happens next:
done.createdNoOwner: {{code}} has been created. What happens next:
done.attached: The picture is attached to the case.
done.attachFailed: The picture was not attached. You can attach it from the case.

near_miss.chip: Someone was hurt or nearly hurt
near_miss.label: Injury or near miss

next.assessAuthority: {{owner}} decides by {{deadline}} whether it must be reported to the data protection authority.
next.informCustomerRisk: {{customer}} is told if the risk to them is high.
next.breachLearn: When the case is closed, we suggest measures so it does not happen again, for example not storing customer data locally.
next.breachAsIncident: {{owner}} follows up the case and decides by {{deadline}} whether it must be reported to the data protection authority.
next.hseFollowUp: {{owner}} follows up and makes sure nobody gets hurt.
next.securityContain: {{owner}} limits the damage, for example by blocking access.
next.findCause: You find the cause and decide what to do.
next.closeAndLearn: When the measures work, the case is closed and you learn from it.
next.ideaFeedback: You will hear what happens with the idea.

cases.title: Cases
cases.intro: Everything that has been reported: deviations, incidents, breaches, complaints and ideas. Follow each case from report to close.

empty.openBody: Everything reported has been followed up. If something has happened, you can report it right away.
empty.mineBody: Here you see cases you reported or are responsible for.
empty.closedBody: Cases that have been followed up and closed end up here.
empty.filteredBody: Try another filter or search word.
